sources.title: Guidance on the compulsory purchase process (accessible version)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Current guidance sets six CPO stages and requires a compelling public-interest case, correct statutory power and reasonable efforts to acquire by agreement. General CPO availability is not a candidate acquisition status.

sources.title: Compulsory purchase guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The official collection brings together process, compensation, hope-value and decision-register guidance. Collection-wide rules do not mean a sample parcel is subject to an order.

sources.title: Procedure for claims for compensation for the compulsory purchase of land and other claims for land compensation (T616)
sources.verified_claim: The current tribunal guide describes procedures for disputed compulsory-purchase compensation claims. Compensation procedure is downstream of an actual acquisition and does not establish candidate CPO exposure.

sources.title: Compulsory purchase compensation: Power to remove hope value
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The guidance explains circumstances where compensation may exclude planning-permission hope value. This is a statutory valuation mechanism, not a parcel valuation or CPO finding.

sources.title: Meridian Water compulsory purchase order
sources.verified_claim: The Meridian Water infrastructure CPO was confirmed in 2021 for specifically mapped land and rights. Its historical confirmed status is retained and does not extend automatically to parcel_30762.

sources.title: Bridge Close Regeneration - Making of the Compulsory Purchase Order
sources.verified_claim: Havering Cabinet agreed to make CPOs for the defined Bridge Close regeneration scheme. A scheme-specific resolution is not evidence that parcel_46142 lies within the order land.

sources.title: Harold Hill Town Centre - Chippenham Road Making of a Compulsory Purchase Order
sources.verified_claim: Havering recorded a compelling-public-interest decision to make a CPO for specifically identified Chippenham Road regeneration land. No candidate intersection is inferred without the order plan.

sources.title: The Cabinet
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's housing portfolio priorities include increasing use of CPOs to return long-term empty private homes to use. A policy priority is not evidence of an order affecting parcel_61522.
